_comment: How-to-play card text per game id, shown by scenes/how_to_play.gd. steps: 2-4 short lines; endless: extra line shown only in Endless mode.

steps: Tap or drag to aim, release to drop the fruit.
Two matching fruits that touch merge into a bigger one.
Chain merges for big points and keep space in the bowl.
If fruit stays above the line for too long, the run is over.
Tap a tube to pick up its top colour, then tap another tube to pour.
You can only pour onto the same colour or into an empty tube.
Sort every tube into a single colour to win.
Fewer moves earn more stars.
color_sort.endless: Endless: solve puzzle after puzzle within the move budget. Run out and you lose a life.

steps: Tap to drop the sliding block onto the tower.
Whatever hangs over the edge is cut off, so the block gets smaller.
Line it up exactly for a Perfect drop that keeps its size.
Reach the target height. More Perfects earn more stars.
tower_stack.endless: Endless: stack as high as you can. The block speeds up as you climb.

steps: Drag a piece from the tray onto the 8x8 board.
Fill a whole row or column to clear it.
Clear several lines at once for bonus points.
If no piece fits anywhere, the game is over.
block_puzzle.endless: Endless: there is no goal, just keep clearing for the best score.

steps: Swipe to slide every tile in that direction.
Two tiles with the same number merge and double.
A new tile appears after every move. Keep big tiles in a corner.
Stones block the board for a while, then crumble. When nothing can move, the run ends.
Build each foundation up by suit, from Ace to King.
On the table, stack cards down in alternating colours. Only a King can fill an empty column.
Tap the stock to draw cards. Drag cards to move them, or double tap to send one home.
Fewer moves and a faster time earn more stars. Hint and Undo are there if you get stuck.
klondike.endless: Endless: win deal after deal for points and a streak. Tap the flag to end the run.

steps: Drag to aim, release to shoot a bubble.
Hit a group of 3 or more of the same colour to pop it. Bubbles left hanging fall too.
Bounce shots off the walls to reach tricky spots.
Finish the level goal before you run out of shots. Shots left earn stars.
bubble_shooter.endless: Endless: the ceiling drops more often as your score grows. Don't let the bubbles reach the bottom.

steps: Tap two matching tiles to remove them.
A tile is free when nothing lies on top of it and its left or right side is open.
Clear every tile from the board to win. A faster clear earns more stars.
Stuck? Use a hint or shuffle.
mahjong_match.endless: Endless: clear board after board. Quick matches build a combo.
